hooks.name: Science invariant review
hooks.description: After the agent edits core science code, inject a short invariant checklist.

action.prompt: You just edited science-critical code. Check the diff against science-invariants.md and answer in at most 6 bullets: NaN handling (never filled with numbers outside clustering); units in names; pooled scaling (no per-body scaler); same slope algorithm and ~470 m baseline across bodies; unmatchable conditions not scored; seeds used for randomness. Fix any violation now and add or update a unit test that would catch it.
